headline: A Pakistani resident was critically injured and a Bahraini citizen with disabilities was injured in Iranian attacks on Bahrain on Saturday night, Bahrain's interior ministry said on Sunday, Dawn (AFP) reports.

card.desc: Bahrain ke mutabiq zakhmi Pakistani ki haalat tashweesh-naak, hospital mein ilaj jari

caption:
Bahrain par Iran ke hamlon mein ek Pakistani shadeed zakhmi! 🙏
Dawn (AFP) ke mutabiq Bahrain ki interior ministry ne Sunday ko bataya ke Saturday raat Iran ke hamlon mein do log zakhmi hue: Bahrain mein rehne wala ek Pakistani, jis ki haalat tashweesh-naak hai, aur ek mazoor Bahraini shehri, jis ki haalat mustehkam hai. Dono hospital mein zer-e-ilaj hain. Ministry ke mutabiq Saturday raat ek civilian industrial facility par hamla hua jis se aag lagi aur nuqsan hua.
Allah zakhmi Pakistani bhai ko jald sehat ata farmaye. Khaleej mein rehne wale apne pyaron ke liye aap kya dua karte hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
